description: Participation admission requirements: contexts can declare verifiable participation criteria for admission, enforced mechanically. RequireParticipation type with ParticipationFact/ParticipationThreshold enums, ParticipationProfile as a full participation profile (all 7 fact categories) produced and hosted by source contexts on their relays. Agents CANNOT write, modify, or delete their own statements — contexts control the storage. Agent opts in by allowing contexts to publish statements. DID document ParticipationStatements service endpoint for verifier discovery. Admitting contexts fetch statements from the service endpoint, verify Ed25519 signatures from distinct context-specific signers, and evaluate against RequireParticipation admission thresholds. FFI exposure across Python/UniFFI/NAPI bridges.

stories.title: Implement RequireParticipation, ParticipationFact, ParticipationThreshold, and ParticipationProfile types
stories.description: Add the RequireParticipation struct, its constituent enums (ParticipationFact, ParticipationThreshold), and the ParticipationProfile struct to the trust/participation module, as specified in §7.3.2.1. ParticipationFact has 7 variants: ParticipationDuration, GovernanceActionsAgainst, GovernanceActionsBy, ToolInvocationCount, ContextCreationCount, RoleProgressionCount, AttestationCount. ParticipationThreshold has 5 variants: GreaterThan(u64), LessThan(u64), AtLeast(u64), AtMost(u64), Equals(u64). RequireParticipation has 4 fields: fact (ParticipationFact), threshold (ParticipationThreshold), max_age_secs (u64), min_contexts (u32). ParticipationProfile is a full participation profile — one statement per member per context, mutated in place. It contains all 7 fact categories as individual u64 fields: participation_duration_secs, governance_actions_against, governance_actions_by, tool_invocation_count, context_creation_count, role_progression_count, attestation_count. Additional fields: subject_did (DID), updated_at (u64), event_log_root ([u8; 32]), signer_public_key ([u8; 32]), signature (Ed25519Signature as [u8; 64]). The statement intentionally omits context_id — this is the privacy guarantee. All types derive Serialize/Deserialize/Debug/Clone/PartialEq/Eq. Add methods on ParticipationFact to extract the corresponding value from a ParticipationProfile, on ParticipationThreshold to check satisfaction, and on ParticipationProfile to produce the signable bytes (all fields except signature, in deterministic order).

stories.title: Integrate participation_requirements into ContextParams admission requirements
stories.description: Add a participation_requirements field (Vec<RequireParticipation>) to ContextParams, with #[serde(default)] for backwards compatibility. stories.title: Implement verification of participation admission requirements from fetched statements
stories.description: Implement the verification function that checks a set of ParticipationProfiles (fetched from a joining agent's DID document ParticipationStatements service endpoint) against a context's Vec<RequireParticipation> admission requirements, per §7.3.2.1 verification flow. The function takes the current timestamp, the requirements, and the fetched signed statements. For each requirement it verifies: (a) each statement's Ed25519 signature is valid over its signable_bytes using its signer_public_key, (b) signers are distinct (N different signer_public_key values proving N independent contexts), (c) the required fact value (extracted from the full profile via ParticipationFact::extract_value) meets the threshold (using ParticipationThreshold::is_satisfied from SCP-BA-001), (d) the statement's updated_at is within max_age_secs of current time, (e) statements span at least min_contexts distinct signers. Returns Ok(()) if all requirements are satisfied, or an error indicating which requirement failed and why.

stories.title: Implement context-hosted ParticipationProfile production and storage
stories.description: Implement the protocol operation where a context produces and hosts a ParticipationProfile (full participation profile) for each opted-in member, per §7.3.2.1. Key properties: (1) Contexts produce statements — agents CANNOT write, modify, or delete them. (2) One statement per member per context, mutated in place (not appended). (3) Whenever underlying facts change (governance action, role transition, tool invocation milestone, etc.), the context re-computes all 7 fact values from the event log, updates updated_at, re-signs the statement, and replaces the prior version. (4) Statements are stored on the source context's relay — the context controls the storage. (5) Members must opt in before the context produces a statement for them. The context-specific signing key must be deterministically derived from the context's key material with domain separation ('scp-participation-statement-v1') so verifiers see a consistent signer for a given context but cannot correlate it to the context identity.

stories.title: Register ParticipationStatements service endpoint in DID documents
stories.description: Add support for a ParticipationStatements service endpoint in DID documents, per §7.3.2.1. The endpoint points to a relay or aggregation endpoint where the agent's participation fact statements can be fetched by admitting contexts. When an agent opts into participation statement publication from one or more contexts, their DID document is updated to include this service entry. The endpoint type is 'ParticipationStatements' and the serviceEndpoint value is the URL where statements are served. Admitting contexts resolve the joining agent's DID document, find this service entry, and fetch statements from it as part of the verification flow.
